pressure_eq.mathematical_idea: prescribed pressure/density plus first-order 1.5*u1-0.5*u2 velocity extrapolation, equilibrium replacement on missing incoming links
pressure_eq.pull_fetch_semantics: globBC incoming-link writes use FETCH; PULL storage is inverse because the kernel performs missing-neighbor bounce-back
pressure_eq.curved_false_requirement: not source-enforced; numerical plane still must supply a valid constant discrete normal
pressure_eq.straight_boundary_requirement: not declared, but two neighbors are selected along one normalInd
pressure_eq.oblique_plane_suitability: conditional on a stable D3Q19 normalInd and two interior neighbors

pressure_nonEqExpol.mathematical_idea: prescribed pressure equilibrium plus the first interior neighbor's non-equilibrium distribution
pressure_nonEqExpol.pull_fetch_semantics: updates all local directions through FETCH from one pre-collision overnext-neighbor buffer
pressure_nonEqExpol.curved_false_requirement: source header calls it a straight-boundary method and fixes qVal=0
pressure_nonEqExpol.oblique_plane_suitability: only when the rasterized boundary has one coherent normal direction

pressure_antiBounceBack.mathematical_idea: anti-bounce-back Dirichlet pressure term with non-equilibrium correction and extrapolated boundary velocity
pressure_antiBounceBack.pull_fetch_semantics: writes missing incoming links with FETCH and reads one post-collision neighbor buffer
pressure_antiBounceBack.curved_false_requirement: no fractional boundary distance is read
pressure_antiBounceBack.straight_boundary_requirement: assumes a consistent boundary normal/neighbor direction
pressure_antiBounceBack.oblique_plane_suitability: source-implemented but must be benchmarked for orientation sensitivity
pressure_antiBounceBack.citation: Musubi native implementation; no copied code

press_neq.mathematical_idea: prescribed pressure equilibrium plus locally copied non-equilibrium component scaled by 1-omega
press_neq.pull_fetch_semantics: updates only incoming globBC links through FETCH
press_neq.curved_false_requirement: no q-value or geometric intersection distance is used
press_neq.oblique_plane_suitability: link-local but not selected for the bounded benchmark candidate set
press_neq.citation: Guo & Shi non-equilibrium pressure treatment as documented in source

pressure_expol.mathematical_idea: pressure and velocity extrapolation using two interior neighbors
pressure_expol.pull_fetch_semantics: two pre-collision neighbor buffers; qVal forcibly zero
pressure_expol.oblique_plane_suitability: conditional on a coherent discrete normal

selection_reason: CURRENT plus two pressure-Dirichlet, D3Q19-compatible, source-proven alternatives; pressure_nonEqExpol is prioritized by the task and pressure_antiBounceBack offers a distinct one-neighbor reconstruction.
